clips.note: Panda Pour, PROXY, raw (pouring/ours/4_raw) 0-8.6 s: grasp ~1-2.5 s, pitcher tilted over the teacup ~5.0-8.2 s; cut as the pitcher starts lifting away, before it is carried back (~9-12 s) and dropped on its side (~16 s).

UR5 Pour, PROXY, raw (pour/ours/9_raw) 0.8-10.03 s: arm moves at 1.1 s, grasps, pitcher tilted over the teacup ~5.5-7.5 s, set back upright ~8.5 s, arm returns home by 10.0 s. Trial 9 is not clean at full frame: a seated person leans in at the right edge (head and shoulders from source ~6.1 s) and the side of their face (cheek, glasses rim) shows for 2 frames at source 6.23-6.27 s, x>=1245. So the clip is cropped to 1216x684 (x 0-1215, y 18-701), as in the hero and run-ur5-pour-a/b, which leaves only hair at the right edge (checked frame by frame, output 5.2-5.7 s). Trial 10 is the gallery's UR5 Pour tile; trial 4 shows a full face at the left (~7.6 s).
Panda Stack, PROXY, raw (bowls/ours/3_raw) 0-9.9 s: grasp ~1-2.5 s, yellow bowl carried and nested in the blue bowl ~6.5-7.5 s, gripper leaves frame ~9.3 s.

UR5 Stack, PROXY, raw (bowls/ours/9_raw) 0.65-9.8 s: arm moves at 1.0 s, yellow bowl grasped and lifted ~2-2.5 s, carried over the blue bowl and lowered into it ~7.0-7.5 s, nested ~7.5-8.5 s, gripper releases and the arm returns home by ~9.5 s; bowls nested at the end. Trial 9, like the other UR5 Tasks clips (Hook, Place, Pour); it replaces trial 7, which is the gallery's UR5 Stack trial 7 tile. Edge strips checked on every frame: only the robot arm enters at the right, no people.
